paite: Mengmuhna Phaizang puakgik Bang na chi ua amai, intung a na kaltouh vek uh?
heading: Jerusalem Diklouhna Taina
english: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

paite: Aw kikou husa a dim, khopi chiak vengvung, kho kipaktak, na sung a athahte uh namsau a thah ahi kei ua, kidouna a si leng ahi sam kei uh.
english: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

paite: Na vaihawmmi tengteng ataimang chiat ua, thalkap mite gak in a-om ua, gamlapi a kipan a hong taimangte.
english: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n, "Hon en lou in lehlam en un, nakpi in ka kap ding; ka mite tanu gallak a alak thu uah hon nem vanglak dah un," ka chi hi.
english: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

paite: Toupa, sepaihte' PATHIAN a kipan in mengmuhna phaizang ah buaina, sikdenna leh mangbatna ni lah ahi ngal a; kulhpi baang hihsiatna leh tangte sapna.
english: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”

paite: Huchi in Elamte'n thalbawm atawi ua, mihing tuanna kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite toh; Kir in lum alakhia hi.
english: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, na phaizang hoihpente lah kangtalai in adimta a, sakol tungtuang mite lah kulh kongkhak bul ah akiphu noinoi uh. Huan Judahte khuhna alamang hi.
english: It happened that your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

paite: Judahte khuhna alamangta. Huchi in huai ni in gammang inn a galthuamna lam na enta uhi.
english: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

paite: David khopi kulhpi siatnate leng na en ua, atam chih na thei uh; huchi in dil khangnungzaw tuite na luangkhawmsak uhi.
english: You saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

paite: Jerusalem innte na sim ua, kulhpi bang bawlhoihna ding in innte na phel uhi.
english: You numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

paite: Dil luitui omna ding in kulhpi nih kikal ah tui chinkhawmna na bawl ua; himahleh huai hihmi lam na en kei ua, nidanglai a ana bawlpa na limsak het kei uhi.
english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who purposed it long ago.

paite: Huai ni in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, kap ding leh awm kitum ding leh lu giausak ding leh sai-ip puan teng ding in asam a;
english: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth:

paite: himahleh, ngai in, nopna leh kipahnate, bawng thahna leh belam thahnate, sa nekna leh uain dawnnate a-om zawta a, ne ni, dawn ni, zingchiang a si ding i hi ngal ua, achi uhi.
english: and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA tuh ka bil ah akilak a, "Pel lou in hiai khelhna na sih masiah uh na lak uah silsiang ahita kei ding, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, hichi in achi, "Kuan inla, hiai sumkempa kiang ah, Shebna, inn tung a heutu a om kiang ngeingei ah, hoh in.
heading: Shebna Tung a Vauhilhna
english: Thus says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

paite: Akiang ah huchi in gen in: Hiai a bang hih na hia? Hiai ah kua na nei a, hiai a han na khuak vial? Amah a ding in sangpi a ahan akhuak a, amah a dia suangpi a omna abawl vial!
english: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA'N nang apaih in ahon pai ek ding, mihat in apaih bang in; ahi, atun in nang ahon tun ding hi.
english: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

paite: Pel lou in ama'n nang lum bang in ahon pei ding a, gam zapi ah ahon vawklut ding a; huai ah na si ding a, huai lai mah ah, nang, na pu insung zahlaksakpa, na thupina kangtalaite a-om ding hi.
english: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you shame of your lord’s house.

paite: Na nasepna a kipan ka hon delhkhe ding a, ama'n heutu na hihna a kipan ahon kaikhesuk ding hi.
english: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

paite: "Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, ka sikha Eliakim, Hilkiah tapa ka sam ding a; amah na puanaktual ka silhsak ding a,
english: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

paite: na kawnggak in ka hihhat ding a na vaihawmna amah khut ah ka kemsak ding. Huchi in Jerusalem a omte a ding in leh Judah inkuanpihte a ding in pa ahi ding.
english: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

paite: Huan David inkuanpihte chabi aliangzang ah ka koih ding a; ama'n ahong ding a, kuamah in akhak kei ding uh; akhak ding a kuamah in ahong kei ding uh.
english: I will lay the key of the house of David on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.

paite: Amah kilhna mun kiptak a akilh ngiungeu bang un, ka hihkip ngiungeu ding a; huchi in amah apa inkuanpihte a ding in laltutphah thupi mahmah ahi ding hi.
english: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

paite: "Amah ah apa inkuanpihte thupina tengteng abang vek ding ua, atate leh asuante, tui-um belsuan neu chiteng, belhbu tui-um belsuan a kipan tui koihna tui-um belsuan tengteng tan in.
english: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.

paite: Huai ni in kilhna, mun kiptak a kilh ngiungeu a om in anangzou kei ding a; satkhiak a om in, aketa ding a, atung a thil gik om lah hihmanthat in a-omta ding a; TOUPA'N huai lah agenta ngal a, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down, and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
